# Garden plan

A plan for the small yard behind the flat, shared between Sam and Rae.

## Tomatoes

Sam plants the heirloom tomatoes along the south fence in the second week of May, once the nights stay above ten degrees. Each plant gets a cane and a handful of crushed eggshell.

## Compost

Rae turns the compost bin every Sunday morning and keeps a ratio of roughly two parts dry leaves to one part kitchen scraps. The finished compost goes on the raised beds in autumn.
